reading_rule: The ocean models' upstream sources, each pinned by its release tag and commit; builds.py refuses a checkout at any other commit and a library package whose sha256 differs. The checkouts and builds live on the research drive (TERLUNA_OCEAN_DRIVE, default /media/projectspace/terluna-research/ocean), outside Git.

mitgcm.name: MITgcm
mitgcm.changes: None. Lunar gravity, radius, rotation and the tide's geopotential are run-time settings and input files.

schism.name: SCHISM
schism.changes: schism/lunar.patch: lunar gravity and rotation as compiled constants, the Moon's radius as the default sphere, the Moon's tide read as a basis of equilibrium-height fields with their coefficients through time (ilunartide=1), aborts for Earth's tidal constituents and for the sflux bulk formulas, and the Moon's sphere in the output metadata.

libraries.reading_rule: Ubuntu 24.04 packages unpacked without root beside the system's own NetCDF and HDF5 runtimes (libnetcdf.so.19, libhdf5_serial.so.103); the same three packages and hashes as the snow work's SCALE build.
